The '''Cryptanalysis Department''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] that was created by Director [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]]. Formed during the early months of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and led by [[Ilko Deminar]], the Cryptanalysis Department was tasked with countering the slicers who were working for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], [[Cryptanalysis]] or Crypt, as it became known, rooted out all coded messages and came under the auspices of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].
